subject: Brightwater onboarding: MSA + Order Form intake and initial asks
messages:
From: Susan Park <susan@brightwater.ai>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: Brightwater Legal <legal@brightwater.ai>; Tom Li <tom.li@brightwater.ai>
Date: Sat, 15 May 2027 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Brightwater onboarding: MSA + Order Form intake

Marissa —

Thanks for the quick intro call earlier. We’re ready to move forward with Redwood for inference across our analytics platform; procurement asked me to kick off contracting so we can align on timeline and evidence. Attaching our standard intake spreadsheet for party/contact info and an SOW draft that outlines expected traffic and residency needs.

High-level asks from legal/procurement:
- We need a copy of your standard MSA (editable) and any common exhibits for hosting/residency.
- SOC 2 Type II report + last penetration-test summary (or a pointer to where we can retrieve).
- Clarify data residency options (US multi-region vs single region) and whether Private deployment is available for our plan.
- Initial commercial: 12-month commitment, expected token volume ~75M/month; we’ll want draft order form and a ballpark on committed throughput pricing.

Can you confirm who from Redwood should own the redline thread and whether you prefer an initial tracker spreadsheet? Ideally we’d collect party details and signer info this week and aim to have a first-pass redline back by May 20.

Thanks —
Susan Park
Head of Legal Operations
Brightwater AI

Attachment: Brightwater_PartySheet.xlsx (xlsx) — contact rows + signer matrix
Attachment: Brightwater_SOW_Draft.docx (docx)
From: Marissa Cole <marissa@redwoodinference.com>

Date: Sat, 15 May 2027 10:05:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Brightwater onboarding: MSA + Order Form intake

Susan — thanks for the packet and the clear asks. Looping in Kimberly (contracts lead) and Jonas (solutions/legal ops partner) to own the intake + redline.

Quick summary of next steps from our side:
- I’ve attached our intake template populated with the party/contact details you provided and a short checklist for evidence (see attached).
- Kimberly — can you take primary ownership of the MSA redline? If yes, we’ll track in the shared redline tracker and put a hard deadline for first-pass comments on the MSA by EOD 20 May.
- Jonas — can you confirm hosting option choices that map to Brightwater’s residency ask? If Private deployment is needed we’ll flag required procurement/engineering timelines.
- Tom — please confirm the signer (name/email) and whether finance wants the PO to be referenced on the order form.

Attachments from Redwood:
- RW_PartySheet_Populated.xlsx (party sheet + signer rows)
- RW_Intake_Checklist.pdf (short checklist of required evidence)

I’ll schedule a 30-minute sync for Monday to walk through any unanswered questions.

Best,
Marissa Cole

Redwood Inference

Date: Sun, 16 May 2027 08:30:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Brightwater onboarding: MSA + Order Form intake

Marissa/Jonas — I can take point on the redline. A few clarifying items before we start edits so the first pass is actionable:

1) Security/compliance evidence
- Susan: please share the SOC 2 Type II report (redacted ok) and an outline of any multi-tenant segregation requirements. If there is a legal NDA/urn for the SOC report portal, send link.
- Also confirm whether we should expect an ATO or security questionnaire from your security team (we can respond via our security portal).

2) Data residency & hosting
- Jonas: we need to know whether Brightwater requires an on-prem or VPC Private control-plane deployment, or whether routing to US-only hosted regions is sufficient. Private deployment will add ~6-8 weeks to delivery and impact the order form language.

3) Billing & signer
- Tom: please confirm billing contact and the authorized signatory name/email for executing the MSA + order form. If procurement requires a specific invoice cadence (monthly vs quarterly) note that here.

4) Clause priorities — tell us the top 3 negotiation priorities (examples: indemnity cap, data residency, audit rights). We will triage the redline accordingly.

I’ve created an initial tracker and seeded an MSA template with party info; attaching redline_tracker.csv to route comments. Plan: first-pass redline (comments + alternate language) by 2027-05-20 COB. If we see high-risk asks we’ll flag for legal leadership review and escalate.

Regards,
Kimberly Park
Lead, Contracts & Commercial Legal
Redwood Inference

Attachment: redline_tracker.csv (csv)

Susan/Tom — quick update after our internal scan and the intake work Kimberly kicked off:

- SOC 2: We can provide a redacted SOC 2 Type II and our pen-test summary via the security portal. I’ll share the link in a follow-up separate email to your security alias.
- Hosting: Jonas confirms US-hosted regions meet the stated residency needs if Brightwater does not require a fully private control-plane. If you do require Private deployment please let us know and we’ll prep an architecture/time-to-delivery estimate (again this will add ~6 weeks).
- Commercial: I’ve attached an initial order form skeleton and marked the expected committed throughput for 75M tokens/month. We’ve included a placeholder for PO number and an optional early-termination credit schedule (open to discussion).
- Redlines: Kimberly attached the initial redline tracker and our seeded MSA (Initial_Redline_MSA_v1.docx). Please review and tell us top negotiation priorities so we can focus the first pass.

Proposed next step: 30-minute call Friday, May 20 at 10:00 AM PT to walk redline priorities and signer flow. If that works for you I’ll send a calendar invite and a DocuSign skeleton for the order form so procurement can preview execution steps.

Thanks — looking forward to getting this moving.

Marissa Cole
